messages:
Leah CS: Quick heads-up — Artemis Labs spiked token consumption after a bulk data import. Need a crisp QBR-ready blurb and immediate mitigation plan.
cost-bot: Alert: account=Artemis Labs usage +3.6x (24h), projected 7-day burn +420% ⚠️
Marco (CSM): Oof. Can we identify the offending endpoints? similarity or generation?
Leah CS: Looks embedding + nearest-neighbor scans. Raw: 24h_total_tokens=2.15M, calls≈50, avg_call≈43k, big_jobs=3.
Samir Eng: Short fix we can flip now: route heavy embedding calls to low-cost embed model, enable batching and prefix caching. Suggested config: route: /v1/embeddings -> tiny-embed-v2; batch_size=64; cache_prefix=on; throttle=60rps.
Priya Finance: If unchanged, credits gone in ~9 days. I'll run a 30-day spend forecast and flag renewal risk if cushion <20%. Also propose temporary alerts at 60%/90% usage.
Marco (CSM): I'll own customer comms. Plan to propose 7-day throttle + a 30-45m enablement to optimize ingestion/query patterns. Need a one-paragraph customer note.
Nora Product: For QBR slide — call out cause (bulk ingestion + sync scans), immediate steps (route+throttle+batching), estimated savings (~50-60%), and long-term ops (precompute embeddings, scheduled reindexes, guardrail quotas).
Leah CS: Action items: Marco -> send customer note and request ack (ETA 2pm PT). Samir -> push routing canary + rollback plan (ETA EOD). Priya -> post updated forecast & mark renewal risk (ETA 4pm). Nora -> draft slide with numbers.
Samir Eng: Canary rolled to 10% traffic now. Will post metrics in 15m. Expect token reduction without major latency impact.
Marco (CSM): Draft message to customer: "We observed a sudden increase in embedding runs after your import. To avoid rapid credit depletion, we recommend a short throttling window and temporary switch to a cost-optimized embedding model while we run an enablement session to optimize queries. We'll monitor and revert once youre comfortable." Please review/soften.
Leah CS: Approved — add a line offering a one-time temporary cushion if mitigation doesn't reduce burn quickly (finance sign-off needed).
cost-bot: Incident logged: INC-2023168, severity=medium, owner=Marco (CSM).
Priya Finance: Modeling cushion now. If we provide a small top-up, runway extends by ~7 days at current burn. I'll paste numbers when ready.
Samir Eng: Canary metrics: canary_ok=true; median_latency_diff=+10ms; token_savings_est=~58% on embed workload; errors=1/420. Rolling to 100% in 30m if stable.
Marco (CSM): Customer ACKed the plan and agreed to the enablement session this week. Asked about temporary credit expansion — I'll loop finance after Priya posts numbers.
Leah CS: Thanks. Capture final numbers and timeline for the QBR slide. Closing loop once forecast + cushion decision are posted. :thumbsup:
